{{Top|leg}}
The '''Spacer's Section''' in [[Celanon City]]<ref name="PoG1">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref> was a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> and [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. More dangerous than [[Celanon Spaceport]], the goods available in the Spacer's Section were a lot cheaper but their origins were questionable. [[Spacer/Legends|Spacers]] could find cargos with no questions asked within the Spacer's Section.<ref name="PoG1" />
